models.title: Indirect reconciliation of operating cash flow
models.summary: Net income is reconciled to operating cash flow using noncash, nonoperating and working-capital adjustments.

relationship.original_equation: CFO = net income + noncash adjustments - nonoperating gains - increase in operating assets + increase in operating liabilities
relationship.locator: Steps 1 and 4; Prepare the Operating Activities Section
relationship.translation_notes: Operating asset and liability changes are ending minus beginning; negative net nonoperating gains represent losses.

models.summary: Beginning retained earnings plus net income less dividends gives ending retained earnings in the simplified roll-forward.

relationship.original_equation: Ending retained earnings = beginning retained earnings + net income - dividends
relationship.translation_notes: Net income and retained earnings may be negative; dividends are the amount charged, not inferred cash payments.
